title: Where Does Hindsight Enter Clinical Agent Benchmarks? An Audit of Simulators and Case Construction
abstract: arXiv:2611.22241v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Benchmarks for LLM diagnostic agents are built from retrospective records: the case an agent reads is rewritten from discharge summaries, and unrecorded test results are generated by a simulator that often sees the final diagnosis. HindAudit separates three hindsight channels (the diagnosis given to the simulator, the retrospective context it conditions on, and the agent-facing case text) and measures each with judges trained only on real data. On 27,489 emergency admissions from MIMIC-IV, five registered tests found no leakage into simulated laboratory results: providing the diagnosis to five simulators had a negligible effect, and prompted gatekeepers diluted the diagnostic signal, although exploratory results suggest they can raise agent scores. The largest effect lay in the case text. Against a presentation-time reconstruction from triage records, benchmark-style summaries raised the zero-shot accuracy of four LLMs from 25.4% to 39.7

translated_title: 后见之明从何进入临床智能体基准测试？对模拟器与病例构建的审计
translated_abstract: 用于大语言模型诊断智能体的基准测试是基于回顾性病历记录构建的：智能体所阅读的病例由出院小结改写而成，而未记录的检查结果则由一个往往能看到最终诊断的模拟器生成。HindAudit 将三条后见之明通道（提供给模拟器的诊断、模拟器所依据的回顾性上下文、以及面向智能体的病例文本）分离开来，并使用仅在真实数据上训练的评判器分别进行测量。基于 MIMIC-IV 中 27,489 例急诊入院数据，五项预先注册的测试未发现模拟实验室结果中存在信息泄露：向五个模拟器提供诊断的影响微乎其微，而提示词引导的守门员稀释了诊断信号，尽管探索性结果表明它们可以提高智能体的得分。最大的效应出现在病例文本中：与基于分诊记录的就诊时点重建相比，基准风格的病历摘要将四个大语言模型的零样本诊断准确率从 25.4% 提升至 39.7%。
tldr: 该论文提出 HindAudit 审计框架，将临床智能体基准测试中的后见之明偏差分离为三条通道并逐一测量，发现模拟实验室结果不存在信息泄露，而最大偏差来自病例文本——基准风格的病历摘要将四个大语言模型的零样本诊断准确率从 25.4% 提升至 39.7%。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces HindAudit, an audit framework that separates three hindsight channels in clinical agent benchmarks and finds no leakage in simulated lab results, while the largest bias lies in case text, where benchmark-style summaries raise the zero-shot accuracy of four LLMs from 25.4% to 39.7%.
